Name: Weekly Networking Lunch
ShortDescription: Casual lunch to meet other members.
LongDescription: Join fellow members for an informal lunch in the communal area. No agenda, no pitches — just a relaxed way to put faces to names and see who else is working nearby.

Name: Monthly All-Hands
ShortDescription: Community update on what's new in the space.
LongDescription: A short, informal update covering what's changed in the space this month — new members, upcoming facilities work, and any community announcements. Drinks and snacks provided.

Name: Yoga Wednesday
ShortDescription: Midweek yoga session for all levels.
LongDescription: A relaxed, all-levels yoga session to break up the week. Mats provided, just bring comfortable clothing. Runs rain or shine in the wellness room.

Name: Summer BBQ
ShortDescription: Our annual summer BBQ for members and their guests.
LongDescription: Food, drinks, and good company on the terrace. Bring a guest if you'd like — just let reception know numbers in advance so we can plan catering.

Name: Workshop: Startup Finance
ShortDescription: Practical session on managing early-stage startup finances.
LongDescription: A hands-on workshop covering the finance basics every early-stage founder needs: cash flow forecasting, runway planning, and what investors actually look for in your numbers.

Name: Workshop: Marketing 101
ShortDescription: Introduction to marketing fundamentals for small teams.
LongDescription: A practical introduction to marketing for founders and small teams with no dedicated marketing hire — covering positioning, low-cost channels, and how to measure what's working.

Name: New Member Orientation
ShortDescription: Everything new members need to know about the space.
LongDescription: A short welcome session covering the essentials: booking rooms, using the app, printing, and who to ask when you need help. Open to all new members, coffee included.

Name: Q3 Town Hall
ShortDescription: Quarterly update and open Q&A with the team.
LongDescription: Our quarterly town hall — an update on what's happened this quarter, what's coming next, and an open floor for questions. All members welcome.

Name: Demo Day
ShortDescription: Members showcase what they're building to the community.
LongDescription: A handful of members take the stage to share what they're working on, in front of the wider community and a few invited guests. Sign up at reception if you'd like to present.

Name: Holiday Party
ShortDescription: End-of-year celebration for the whole community.
LongDescription: Our end-of-year get-together — food, drinks, and a chance to celebrate the year with the community before things wind down for the holidays.

Name: Coffee & Networking
ShortDescription: Drop-in coffee morning, no agenda required.
LongDescription: An informal drop-in session over coffee — come and go as you please. A good excuse to step away from the desk and meet someone new.

Name: Wellness Wednesday: Meditation
ShortDescription: Guided meditation session to reset midweek.
LongDescription: A short guided meditation session to help reset midweek. No experience necessary, just bring yourself and find a quiet spot in the wellness room.

Name: Product Demo Night
ShortDescription: Members demo their products to a friendly audience.
LongDescription: An evening of short product demos from members building something new, followed by informal feedback and networking over drinks.

Name: Investor Pitch Night
ShortDescription: Practice pitches in front of a supportive audience.
LongDescription: A low-pressure environment for members to practice their investor pitch and get honest feedback from peers before the real thing.

Name: Book Club
ShortDescription: Monthly discussion on a business or startup book.
LongDescription: A casual monthly discussion group covering a different business, startup, or productivity book each time. Check the community group for this month's pick.

Name: Freelancer Meetup
ShortDescription: Meetup for freelancers and independent contractors in the space.
LongDescription: A regular meetup for freelancers and independent contractors to swap notes on clients, rates, and the realities of working solo — and to feel a little less solo doing it.

Name: Portfolio Review Session
ShortDescription: Get feedback on your portfolio or project work.
LongDescription: Bring your portfolio or current project for informal feedback from other members working in similar fields. Useful for designers, developers, and creatives alike.

Name: Hackathon Kickoff
ShortDescription: Kickoff session for our community hackathon weekend.
LongDescription: The opening session for our community hackathon — team formation, idea pitching, and ground rules before the building begins.

Name: Year-End Wrap Party
ShortDescription: Casual celebration to close out the year.
LongDescription: A relaxed get-together to mark the end of the year and celebrate what the community built and achieved together.

Name: New Year Kickoff Breakfast
ShortDescription: Start the year with breakfast and a fresh set of goals.
LongDescription: Kick off the new year with breakfast and an informal chat about goals for the months ahead — both for the space and for your own work.
